meta.note: statement time from Python, median of runs after 1 warm-up

token_then_decode_10.sql: SELECT detokenize(encoded_url) AS url, n FROM ( SELECT encoded_url, count(*) AS n FROM urls WHERE token_like(encoded_url, '%.php') GROUP BY encoded_url ORDER BY n DESC, encoded_url LIMIT 10)

decode_all_then_like.sql: SELECT url, count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT detokenize(encoded_url) AS url FROM urls) WHERE url LIKE '%.php' GROUP BY url ORDER BY n DESC, url LIMIT 10

raw_text.sql: SELECT original_url AS url, count(*) AS n FROM urls WHERE original_url LIKE '%.php' GROUP BY original_url ORDER BY n DESC, original_url LIMIT 10

decode_selected.note: The token query orders ties by the BLOB (token-id bytes), the raw query by text, so the URLs inside a tie may differ; verification checks every decoded URL's count against the raw-text GROUP BY and that the 10 counts are the 10 largest.
